master_plan_principles_consumed.principle_text: Dashboard contracts may be schema-only before runtime receipts and must not create a running dashboard, endpoint, login flow, or runtime state.
Owner dashboard packet action semantics remain canonical and display layers may not invent or rename underlying action semantics.
PR96 may display PR93 queue fields but may not fetch, dequeue, approve, reject, reorder, or mutate requests.
PR96 may display override-gate references but may not author owner override receipts or satisfy external requirements.
PR96 consumes PR95 menu option IDs and explicit scope mappings without redefining menu semantics or silently aliasing names.
Owner override cannot fabricate external facts, source packets, connector semantics, runtime cash, order/fill receipts, replay/paper results, backend output, profit, or advantage evidence.
APPROVE_LIVE_USE display does not create live eligibility, canary eligibility, order intent, live routing, or order submission.
APPROVE_QUANTUM_BACKEND display is static metadata only and creates no backend, simulator, provider call, optimizer execution, or quantum advantage evidence.
Static dashboard contracts may not claim profit improvement, latency improvement, execution superiority, live readiness, backend readiness, or quantum advantage.
PR96 does not create PR97 AtomicRows bundle expansion plan, row-family source files, bundle builder, bundle JSONL, or bundle SHA authority.
